isitan-sfb-cnc-a5.name: SFB CNC/A5 — 5-axis servo CNC mandrel tube benders
isitan-sfb-cnc-a5.summary: Fully servo-driven CNC mandrel benders with five axes: servo feed (Y), rotation (B) and bend (C) plus two servo roll-bending axes, so the same machine draw-bends tight radii with the mandrel and roll-bends large sweeps without a tooling change. A mobile 21″ touchscreen CNC with 3D simulation, spring-back and hardness compensation, X-Y-Z to Y-B-C conversion and automatic job reports — for exhaust, chassis, seating and fitness-frame production in Ø1-1/2″ to Ø2-1/2″ tube.
features: Servo-motorized feeding (Y), rotation (B) and bending (C) axes; two axes move together; rotation tolerance ±0.1°
Servo roll-bending axes for large-radius sweeps on the same machine
Mobile CNC control unit with 21″ TFT touchscreen; 3D bending simulation with collision warning; spring-back calculation; hardness compensation
X-Y-Z to Y-B-C conversion; tube-length and bending-time calculation; daily, weekly and monthly reports e-mailed automatically; remote assistance
Hydraulic clamping, mandrel, pressure die, linear slider and collet; bending with or without mandrel; manual and automatic operation

Safety plate behind the bending head; mobile foot pedal with emergency stop; electrical cabinet cooler; lockable panel with safety interlock; overload protection; 1 die set (3 pieces) in requested size
optional: Extra die sets; ball mandrel and wiper die
Extended mandrel length (up to 20 ft)
Automatic mandrel lubrication (SFB 51 / 65)
Hydraulic oil cooler and oil heater
Safety mat 30 × 39″ or 39 × 59″
Custom voltage: 208 V, 240 V, 480 V or 600 V 3-phase, or 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor

isitan-sfb-nc-c.name: SFB NC/C — NC mandrel tube benders with servo-rotation carrier
isitan-sfb-nc-c.summary: An NC mandrel bender with a carrier: the hydraulic collet holds the tube, a servo motor — the same as on the CNC models — rotates it between bends to very low tolerance, and the operator feeds to adjustable stops on the carrier slide while a screen on the carrier shows feed length and rotation angle. Faster and more repeatable than a standard NC bender for series production of furniture, lighting, metal accessories and handrail parts, at a fraction of the price of a CNC.

isitan-bk.name: BK series — rotary draw tube & profile benders (non-mandrel)
isitan-bk.summary: Compact rotary draw benders for tube, pipe, solid bar, flat bar and box section — one tooling set included. The BK-42 and BK 030 (76) have touchscreen NC (PLC) programming with 20 programs of 10 bends, quick-change tooling and a digital angle display; the BK-050 and hydraulic BK-H 060 use a one-touch control any operator can program, with two bending speeds and a foot pedal. From 1-1/4″ NPS pipe on the BK-42 to Ø3″ × 11 ga steel tube on the BK 030 — the bench of handrail, gate, fence and furniture shops.
